veranderings.voor: te beplan om die regering onder druk te plaas
veranderings.na: te beplan wat die regering onder druk moes plaas
veranderings.rede: Two stacked 'om ... te' clauses in one sentence read heavily; a relative clause on 'sabotasie' keeps the purpose and flows better.

veranderings.voor: Wanneer mense wat teenoor mekaar gestaan het, vrede maak en saam vorentoe gaan.
veranderings.na: Om vrede te maak en saam vorentoe te gaan nadat mense teenoor mekaar gestaan het.
veranderings.rede: Defining a noun with 'Wanneer' copies the English 'is when'; the 'Om ... te' form matches the sabotasie entry and keeps the meaning.

vlae.rede: The block heading uses 'erfenis' as a bare predicate, which reads unnaturally; 'deel van ons erfenis' would be more idiomatic, but a heading may not be changeable by the script, so this is flagged for the reviewer or writer.
